fieldData.logistics-info:
This Halloween, follow the white rabbit through the keyhole in the door for an evening inspired by the strange, elegant, and wonderfully curious world of Wonderland. Spend the evening enjoying dinner, drinks, music, dancing, and a few curious surprises along the way. More than a Halloween party, Down the Rabbit Hole is a community event benefiting the Senoia Downtown Development Authority. Our goal is simple: create a fun, memorable annual event for Senoia and the surrounding community while raising funds that can be invested back into downtown Senoia. Come for dinner. Come for the party. Come dressed as someone else entirely. Just don’t be late.

‍

This event is 18+

‍

The evening unfolds in chapters:

CURIOUS KEY VIP: $150

5:30 Entry

VIP guests receive early entry and access to the full evening, including the VIP experience, seated dinner, and the Wonderland After Party.

What’s Included in the VIP experience:

  • Early admission beginning at 5:30 PM
  • Commemorative Photo Keepsake
  • Access to the Stone Lodge ‘tasting room’ (Planned: Bourbon & Wine)
  • Passed Hors D’Oeuvres
  • Ambient entertainment throughout     (Cirque Acrobatics, Tableside Magic)
  • Seated Dinner
  • Cash Bar
  • After dark fire experience
  • Interactive Games
  • Artisan Boutique until 9:30pm
  • Admission to the Wonderland After Party DJ/Dancing

‍

SEATED DINNER: $100

THE MAD TEA PARTY: Entry at 6:30 PM, Dinner at 7:00 PM

Your ticket includes an elegant seated dinner and access to the Wonderland After Party.

What’s Included in the dinner experience:

  • Admission beginning at 6:30 PM
  • Ambient entertainment throughout    (Cirque Acrobatics, Tableside Magic)
  • Seated Dinner
  • Cash Bar
  • After dark fire experience
  • Interactive Games
  • Artisan Boutique until 9:30pm
  • Admission to the Wonderland After Party DJ/Dancing

‍

GENERAL ADMISSION: $25

WONDERLAND AFTER PARTY: Entry at 8:30 PM

Join us after dinner as Wonderland opens its doors for the final chapter of the evening.

What’s Included in the After Party experience:

  • Admission beginning at 8:00 PM
  • Cash Bar
  • After dark fire experience
  • Interactive Games
  • Artisan Boutique until 9:30pm
  • Admission to the Wonderland After Party DJ/Dancing

‍

DRESS CODE: Think masquerade meets Wonderland.

Masks and headpieces are encouraged, black tie and evening wear. Guests are invited to interpret the theme — an elegant masquerade with character: Alice, the White Rabbit, Queen of Hearts, Mad Hatter, Cheshire Cat. An outfit for a whimsical garden party, chess players and playing cards with a touch of mystery. Creative outfits are highly encouraged, but not required.

Event Overview:

Get ready to celebrate the most wonderful time of the year at our annual Light Up Senoia Parade! This cherished tradition brings the community together for an evening of festivities and Christmas cheer! Parade begins promptly at 6:30pm. This is a wonderful way to promote your business and have some holiday fun!

Event Highlights:

  • Festive Floats by local businesses, schools, churches, and organizations
  • Dance Groups
  • Cheerful Music & Holiday Entertainment
  • Food Trucks
  • Santa Claus  
  • Santa's Workshop
  • Main Street Tree Lighting
  • Awards & Trophies
  • & More!

Event Schedule:

4:00pm: Santa's Workshop Opens! Located at the Senoia Farmers' Market, 40 Travis Street

‍4:15pm: Pre parade entertainment begins in front of the stage on Main Street

‍4:30pm-5:30pm: Check in for parade participants (further details below)

‍6:00pm: Santa's Workshop Closes, making your way towards Main Street for the parade!

‍6:30pm: PARADE BEGINS

‍The Light Up Senoia tree lighting will immediately follow the parade. And then Santa will receive visitors on his sleigh until 8:30.

‍

REGISTER TO SUBMIT AN ENTRY IN THE PARADE

The theme for this year’s parade is “Christmas Through the Decades". All parade entries will be judged with the theme as the basis for trophy awards. The following category winners will receive a trophy.

Mayor’s trophy (best overall entry)

Grand Marshal’s trophy (best creative entry)

Santa’s trophy (best Christmas Spirit)

Rudolph’s trophy (best lighted entry)

Reindeer trophy (best musical/vocal/dance entry)

With it being nighttime, we encourage lights! It will be dark when the parade starts, so use those LIGHTS!!! (You will supply all electricity for your entry) Be creative! Please have some type of banner in front of your entry announcing your group's name.

You CAN NOT have a SANTA on your float, Santa will be at the end of the parade on the his Fire Truck.

Please…no items can be thrown from parade participants! You may have someone walking beside your entry to hand out candy, beads etc. This is for the safety of the children. Thank you for your cooperation.

‍There is a $20 fee for each parade entry.

‍CHECK IN TIME FOR PARADE PARTICIPANTS BEGINS AT 4:30 AND ENDS AT 5:30!‍

You will receive multiple emails the week of the parade that will give you all information you need to know beforehand. Please make sure the email you use on the entry form is monitored, AND please put info@enjoysenoia.com in your contact list so your instructions don’t end up in your junk file.

Entries are limited. Sign up NOW!

If you have questions about the parade please email: lightupsenoia@enjoysenoia.com

fieldData.hero-sub-caption: Senoia PorchFest is a hometown community celebration where porches and yards become stages for local and regional bands and musicians!
fieldData.logistics-info:
Senoia PorchFest is a community-based music event that takes place on residential porches as well as downtown businesses! Porches and patios become stages for local and regional bands and musicians. During PorchFest, the performances can range from solo acts, to full bands, with a wide variety of selected genres.

‍

PorchFest is a FREE event to attend, organized and sponsored by the Senoia Downtown Development Authority. However, we encourage you to tip the musicians you are here to enjoy as they are performing for free.

‍

In addition to the music, PorchFest also includes food vendors and kids' activities!

‍

‍

Planning on attending PorchFest Senoia? Here’s what you need to know…

PorchFest is a pedestrian event. Last year’s PorchFest was attended by over 8000 music enthusiasts. The streets where PorchFest will take place will be closed to all automobile and golf cart traffic. Walking shoes and folding chairs are recommended. Limited golf cart shuttles will be available to get participants to the PorchFest perimeter, but no transportation will be available within the perimeter of the event.

‍

Volunteers will be available throughout the neighborhoods to answer any questions.

‍

Maps of the porches/performers will be posted at most intersections.

‍

As you visit each performance, please watch out for plantings in front of homes and businesses and plan to sit or stand on lawns, walkways, sidewalks or closed streets.

‍

Please use caution when walking on streets that are not closed to automobiles, golf carts or bicycles.

‍

For additional information regarding Senoia PorchFest please contact info@enjoysenoia.com

Senoia PorchFest is a community-based music event that takes place on residential porches in Senoia! Porches and yards become stages for local and regional bands and musicians. Senoia’s streets become artist galleries and walk-up restaurants. During PorchFest, local musicians or bands set up on selected porches and perform for an hour. The performances can range from solo acts, to full bands, with a wide variety of selected genres. PorchFest is a FREE event to attend, organized and sponsored by the Senoia Downtown Development Authority. In addition to the music, PorchFest also includes food vendors, art displays, and kids' activities! PorchFest is a celebration of music, creativity, and community! Come enjoy live performances, support local artists, and Enjoy Senoia with us!

Event Overview ...

The Senoia Car Show is an annual event that showcases 500 classic and custom cars from all over Georgia. The event takes place in September and features a range of vehicles, including vintage cars, muscle cars, hot rods, and custom trucks. The Senoia Car Show is a family-friendly event that offers something for everyone. In addition to the impressive collection of cars on display, there are also food vendors, music, door prizes and activities for kids.

One of the highlights of the Senoia Car Show is the opportunity to meet and talk with car owners, who are often passionate enthusiasts who are happy to share their knowledge and stories about their vehicles. Many of the cars on display are restored to their original condition, while others have been customized with modern features and modifications.

The event is held in downtown Senoia, which is a charming and historic town located about 30 miles south of Atlanta. Visitors to the Senoia Car Show can explore the town's shops and restaurants, as well as its many historic sites and landmarks.

The Senoia Car Show is a fun and exciting event that celebrates the rich history and culture of the automobile. Whether you're a car enthusiast or just looking for a fun day out with the family, the Senoia Car Show is definitely worth checking out.The show is open to all cars & trucks 25 years and older (1998 and older).

General non-reserved show car parking will be available soon.  To reserve general non-reserved parking, scroll down the page and click on the Advanced Show Car Reservations button.

‍

‍For more information, please email carshow@enjoysenoia.com

‍

Valve Cover Races - Rules and Regulations

Valve cover racing is a competitive event similar to pinewood derby, but vehicles are made using a valve cover from a car engine rather than a wooden block. Contestants are encouraged to build your own "car" and bring it to the event to race against others. Customization is encouraged per the rules below. The event is open to children and adults of all ages.

‍

Car/Valve Cover Specs

1. Length - up to 30 inches

2. Width - up to 10 inches

3. Height -up to 10 inches

4. Weight - up to 10 pounds

5. No engines or propulsion

6. No moving weights

7. Wheels can be attached to the valve cover in any manner, but must not extend beyond

the front of the valve cover

8. Nothing can extend beyond the front of the valve cover (Car)

9. Cars shall be based on an actual rocker cover from an automobile

10. Cars must have four wheels, each no more than six inches in diameter

‍

The Course

The track will be similar to a Pinewood Derby track. A wooden track with two lanes approximately 20 ft. long and 4ft incline with a single starting gate. Located at the bottom of Main Street during the Senoia Car Show.

The Race

  • ﻿﻿Cars will be run in heats of two cars each
  • ﻿﻿The cars will be launched with the front edge of the valve cover touching the starting gate. The first car to have its front edge cross the finish line will be the winner. If neither car makes it to the finish line, the car going the furthest in its lane wins
  • ﻿﻿Winning cars will advance to the next round until all are eliminated except one car

Event Overview:

Get ready to celebrate the most wonderful time of the year at our annual Light Up Senoia Parade! This cherished tradition brings the community together for an evening of festivities and Christmas cheer! Parade begins promptly at 6:30pm. This is a wonderful way to promote your business and have some holiday fun!

Event Highlights:

  • Festive Floats by local businesses, schools, churches, and organizations
  • Dance Groups
  • Cheerful Music & Holiday Entertainment
  • Food Trucks
  • Santa Claus  
  • Santa's Workshop
  • Main Street Tree Lighting
  • Awards & Trophies
  • & More!

Event Schedule:

4:00pm: Santa's Workshop Opens! Located at the Senoia Farmers' Market, 40 Travis Street

‍4:15pm: Pre parade entertainment begins in front of the stage on Main Street

‍4:30pm-5:30pm: Check in for parade participants (further details below)

‍6:00pm: Santa's Workshop Closes, making your way towards Main Street for the parade!

‍6:30pm: PARADE BEGINS

‍The Light Up Senoia tree lighting will immediately follow the parade. And then Santa will receive visitors on his sleigh until 8:30.

‍

REGISTER TO SUBMIT AN ENTRY IN THE PARADE

The theme for this year’s parade is “A Storybook Christmas". All parade entries will be judged with the theme as the basis for trophy awards. The following category winners will receive a trophy.

Mayor’s trophy (best overall entry)

Grand Marshal’s trophy (best creative entry)

Santa’s trophy (best Christmas Spirit)

Rudolph’s trophy (best lighted entry)

Reindeer trophy (best musical/vocal/dance entry)

With it being nighttime, we encourage lights! It will be dark when the parade starts, so use those LIGHTS!!! (You will supply all electricity for your entry) Be creative! We do ask that you don’t have Santa on your float as he will be at the end of the parade already!! Please have some type of banner in front of your entry announcing your group's name.

Please…no items can be thrown from vehicles! You may have someone walking beside your entry to hand out candy, beads etc. This is for the safety of the children. Thank you for your cooperation.

‍There is a $20 fee for each parade entry.

‍CHECK IN TIME FOR PARADE PARTICIPANTS BEGINS AT 4:30 AND ENDS AT 5:30!‍

You will receive multiple emails the week of the parade that will give you all information you need to know beforehand. Please make sure the email you use on the entry form is monitored, AND please put info@enjoysenoia.com in your contact list so your instructions don’t end up in your junk file.

Entries are limited. Sign up NOW!

If you have questions about the parade please email: lightupsenoia@enjoysenoia.com

‍Event Overview ...

The Senoia Car Show is an annual event that showcases 500 classic and custom cars from all over Georgia. The event takes place in September and features a range of vehicles, including vintage cars, muscle cars, hot rods, and custom trucks. The Senoia Car Show is a family-friendly event that offers something for everyone. In addition to the impressive collection of cars on display, there are also food vendors, music, door prizes and activities for kids. Visitors to the Senoia Car Show can explore the town's shops and restaurants, as well as its many historic sites and landmarks. The Senoia Car Show is a fun and exciting event that celebrates the rich history and culture of the automobile. Whether you're a car enthusiast or just looking for a fun day out with the family, the Senoia Car Show is definitely worth checking out. The show is open to all cars & trucks 25 years and older (2000 and older).

‍

Car Show Itinerary:

10:00a car show officially open

10:30a Pedal Car Silent Auction & Door Prizes begin

11:00a Hot Rod Brothers Car Reveal

11:30a Valve Cover Race 1

12:00p "Crank you Engines"

12:15p Fly Over

12:30p Valve Cover Race 2

1:30p Valve Cover Race 3 (Championship)

3:00p Award Ceremony

4:00p Show ends


To reserve general non-reserved parking, scroll down the page and click on the Advanced Show Car Reservations button.

‍

‍For more information, please email carshow@enjoysenoia.com

‍

  • ‍Venue opens at 7:00am, cars must have paid credentials (adv or same day) to enter and no cars allowed to enter prior to 7:00am
  • On-line registration is preferred (print [or screen shot] your credentials at home), and on-line assistance is available at the Senoia Welcome Center
  • Same day ticket sales available at entrance gates
  • Main Street spots are assigned by number; Maguires lot and general spots are first come/first serve (saving spaces not allowed)
  • Reserved parking not occupied by 10:00am will be forfeited
  • All show car owners must check in by 10a at the Registration Center the day of show
  • Car must be parked, registered and ID card displayed on dash by 10:00am for award eligibility
  • Door prizes available to show car participants; please complete the door prize entry form at registration for eligibility
  • Car hauler parking is available with complimentary shuttle service to/from Main Street, Call the Senoia Welcome Center to schedule.
  • No private business advertisement (sandwich boards, posters, etc) allowed without official sponsorship
  • Vehicles longer than 20’ or wider than 8’ need to register then call Senoia Welcome Center for parking instructions
  • If handicap or other special parking needs are required, please register then call Senoia Welcome Center for arrangements
  • Public (non show car) parking & shuttle service will be available, including handicap and golf cart
  • Due to pedestrian safety Main St will be closed to vehicle traffic during the show.  Show cars will not be allowed to exit until after 4pm.

‍

We’re excited to host a silent auction featuring five one-of-a-kind pedal cars, customized by local shops with unique paint jobs, interiors, and wheels — each turned into a true "hot rod!"

All proceeds will benefit Angel House, a local safe house providing care and support for children in crisis.

Don't miss your chance to own a standout piece — perfect for your man cave, business, or as a special gift for a grandchild.

Silent auction bid sheets will be located near the stage with the pedal cars. Come place your bid and join the fun for a great cause!

‍

Valve Cover Races - Rules and Regulations

Valve cover racing is a competitive event similar to pinewood derby, but vehicles are made using a valve cover from a car engine rather than a wooden block. Contestants are encouraged to build your own "car" and bring it to the event to race against others. Customization is encouraged per the rules below. The event is open to children and adults of all ages.

‍

REGISTER HERE!

‍

Car/Valve Cover Specs

1. Length - up to 30 inches

2. Width - up to 10 inches

3. Height -up to 10 inches

4. Weight - up to 10 pounds

5. No engines or propulsion

6. No moving weights

7. Wheels can be attached to the valve cover in any manner, but must not extend beyond

the front of the valve cover

8. Nothing can extend beyond the front of the valve cover (Car)

9. Cars shall be based on an actual rocker cover from an automobile

10. Cars must have four wheels, each no more than six inches in diameter

‍

The Course

The track will be similar to a Pinewood Derby track. A wooden track with two lanes approximately 20 ft. long and 4ft incline with a single starting gate. Located at the bottom of Main Street during the Senoia Car Show.

The Race

  • ﻿﻿Cars will be run in heats of two cars each
  • ﻿﻿The cars will be launched with the front edge of the valve cover touching the starting gate. The first car to have its front edge cross the finish line will be the winner. If neither car makes it to the finish line, the car going the furthest in its lane wins
  • ﻿﻿Winning cars will advance to the next round until all are eliminated except one car

‍

‍

‍

Mustangs for Military will be on site again this year raffling off a 2007 Shelby GT500 at $40/ticket.  Proceeds provide financial assistance to student veterans who honorably served this country so they may achieve their educational goals.  Visit www.mustangs4military.org for more details.

‍

NEW THIS YEAR: the Senoia Area Historical Society is hosting a local cruise on Friday 9/26 - the day before the car show. The $20 event will be a poker run where participants photograph their car in front of 5 local landmarks, then bring the photos to Marimac Lakes between 6 and 7p to claim 5 playing cards as your "poker hand".   Standard poker rules will be used to determine the best 5 card hand and your chance to win a $200 cash prize..  The winning hand will be awarded at 7p followed by a free hot dog dinner. Proceeds benefit the Senoia Area Historical Society.  

‍

REGISTER HERE!

‍

Unlike the car show, any make/model of car, truck, motorcycle can participate (no vehicle age restriction). Join your friends to make the 60 minute cruise at any time on Friday and compete for the best poker hand and cash prize at 7pm.  There is no official start or finish time, you simply go at your own pace and cruise the landmarks in any order. Use your cell phone to take a selfie, and tell any onlookers to come to the car show on Saturday. Please register at the car show event page on www.enjoysenoia, or https://www.enjoysenoia.com/events/20th-annual-senoia-car-show-2025.  Driving instructions provided below.

‍

Senoia Area Historical Society:

‍The Senoia Area Historical Society’s mission is to secure, preserve, and promote the social and cultural history of the community.  In 1976, a group of townspeople joined together to plan festivities to celebrate our country's Bicentennial. Today, the society has monthly meetings open to the public on the second Thursday of the month at 7 pm in our headquarters/museum. We often host guest speakers at these meetings and we always enjoy the evenings. Our fundraising events are community affairs that capture the society’s unique character.  From Hot Rods for History to the Annual Auction, the year is full of fun and activity.  We also host many community enrichment opportunities such as storytelling events, genealogical seminars and local artists/authors. You do not need to live in Senoia to join the society - membership is open to everyone!The Senoia Area Historical Society (SAHS) is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization dedicated to preserving the social and cultural history of Senoia, Georgia and its surrounding community.  Please consider joining our cause!

www.senoiahistory.com

‍

2025 Senoia Car Show Poker Run driving directions  

Stop1 : Crook's Marketplace mural in downtown Senoia (GPS : 33°18'24.9"N 84°33'16.1"W)

Start at Crook's Marketplace - 7814 Wells St, Senoia, GA 30276 - take your pic in front of the mural and continue on to Stop2.

‍

Stop2 : "Brooks Foundry School" mural located across from the Brooks post office.  (GPS: 33°17'24.4"N 84°27'29.3"W)

Take a left (north) out of Crook's onto Broad Street

Next, veer left onto Travis Street and immediately go right onto Main Street

Stay on Main Street and continue as it becomes Rock-A-Way Road

Continue and then turn right (east) on Hwy 74/Joel Cowan Pkwy

Turn left (north) onto GA Hwy 85 north

Turn right onto Hwy 85 Connector (at Millpond Gardens Garden Center)

Turn left on W.McIntosh Rd. - Look for a mural on the end of the building at 121 W. McIntosh Rd. Take your pic and continue on.

‍

Stop3: "Welcome to Alvaton" mural is painted on the side of a building on Hwy 85 South just north of the town center. (GPS : 33°10'39.5"N 84°34'56.9"W)  

Follow Hwy 85 Connector out of Brooks until you reach the roundabout.

Go straight at the roundabout. Take the second exit onto Hollonville Rd.

Hollonville Rd becomes Kings Bridge Rd. when you cross the bridge

Continue on Kings Bridge Rd. until it dead ends into Hwy 362. The Hollonville Opry House will be on your right.

Before you continue, if you need a quick break, fuel or some refreshments, take a left and Frank's Filling Station is on your left.

Take a right onto Hwy 362.

Continue on Hwy 362 into the town of Alvaton. Turn left onto GA Hwy 85 going south for a very short distance where you will see the mural on the side of the Air Logic Heating and Air Conditioning building (it's small). Pull in and take your pic. Turn left out of Air Logic going north on GA Hwy 85.

‍

Stop4 : SAHS History Museum  is located on Couch Street just off Main St in Senoia (GPS : 33°18'20.6"N 84°33'21.1"W)

Follow Hwy 85 north back to Senoia and turn left on Hwy 16.

Turn right on Broad Street. veer left onto Travis Street and immediately go right onto Main Street

Follow Main Street through town again and turn left on Couch Street.

At the end of that block the Senoia Historical Society is on the right at 6 Couch St, Senoia, GA 30276.Take a pic at the Historical Society and head to the Stone Lodge at Marimac Lakes.  

‍

Stop5: Stone Lodge at Marimac Lakes is located near the Senoia Library off Pylant St (GPS : 33°17'54.7"N 84°33'42.4"W)

Turn left (south) onto Pylant Street

Follow Pylant Street and turn right into the Senoia Branch Library. Proceed across the lake to the Stonelodge. Take your picture in front of the Stone Lodge.

Poker instruction

After you have completed all 5 stops, show your pictures to the "dealer" at the Stone Lodge and receive 5 playing cards for your poker hand.  Winner to be determined by standard poker rules at 7pm.  There will be a hotdog dinner served from 6-8pm compliments of the Senoia Area Historical Society.

Senoia PorchFest 2025

‍

Senoia PorchFest is a community-based music event that takes place on residential porches in Senoia! Porches and yards become stages for local and regional bands and musicians. Senoia’s streets become artist galleries and walk-up restaurants. During PorchFest, local musicians or bands set up on selected porches and perform for an hour. The performances can range from solo acts, to full bands, with a wide variety of selected genres. PorchFest is a FREE event to attend, organized and sponsored by the Senoia Downtown Development Authority. In addition to the music, PorchFest also includes food vendors, art displays, and kids' activities! PorchFest is a celebration of music, creativity, and community! Come enjoy live performances, support local artists, and Enjoy Senoia with us!

‍

Elevate your PorchFest experience by upgrading to VIP! VIP area is located at Senoia Farmer's Market (40 Travis Street) Exclusive VIP guests will receive:

- Reserved Parking

- VIP Bathroom Access (2:00-7:00pm)

- Door Prize Entry to win a basket of spirits valued at $1,000

- Drink Tickets (3) Adult Beverages

- Small Bites

- Commemorative Lanyard

- $15 Gift Card

- Event T-Shirt

- Live Music

‍

‍

Planning on attending PorchFest Senoia? Here’s what you need to know…

PorchFest is a pedestrian event. Last year’s PorchFest was attended by over 5000 music enthusiasts. The streets where PorchFest will take place will be closed to all automobile and golf cart traffic. Attendees are encouraged to park in downtown Senoia and walk to the porches and stages. Walking shoes and folding chairs are recommended. Limited golf cart shuttles will be available to get participants to the PorchFest perimeter, but no transportation will be available within the perimeter of the event.

Volunteers will be available throughout the neighborhoods to answer questions. 

Maps of the porches/performers will be posted at intersections. 

As you visit each porch and performance, please watch out for plantings in front of homes and plan to sit or stand on lawns, walkways, sidewalks or the closed street. 

Please use caution when walking on streets that are not closed to automobiles, golf carts or bicycles. 

For additional information please contact porchfestbands@enjoysenoia.com or info@enjoysenoia.com

Parking and Road Closures

‍

⚠️ Park Closures:

🚫 Road Closures:

  • Pylant Street will be closed from Hwy 16 to Morgan for vehicle traffic.

🛺 Golf Cart Parking:

Valve Cover Races - Rules and Regulations

Valve cover racing is a competitive event similar to pinewood derby, but vehicles are made using a valve cover from a car engine rather than a wooden block. Contestants are encouraged to build your own "car" and bring it to the event to race against others. Customization is encouraged per the rules below. The event is open to children and adults of all ages.

‍

Car/Valve Cover Specs

1. Length - up to 30 inches

2. Width - up to 10 inches

3. Height -up to 10 inches

4. Weight - up to 10 pounds

5. No engines or propulsion

6. No moving weights

7. Wheels can be attached to the valve cover in any manner, but must not extend beyond

the front of the valve cover

8. Nothing can extend beyond the front of the valve cover (Car)

9. Cars shall be based on an actual rocker cover from an automobile

10. Cars must have four wheels, each no more than six inches in diameter

‍

The Course

The track will be similar to a Pinewood Derby track. A wooden track with two lanes approximately 20 ft. long and 4ft incline with a single starting gate. Located at the bottom of Main Street during the Senoia Car Show.

The Race

  • ﻿﻿Cars will be run in heats of two cars each
  • ﻿﻿The cars will be launched with the front edge of the valve cover touching the starting gate. The first car to have its front edge cross the finish line will be the winner. If neither car makes it to the finish line, the car going the furthest in its lane wins
  • ﻿﻿Winning cars will advance to the next round until all are eliminated except one car

Senoia PorchFest is a community-based music event that takes place on residential porches in Senoia! Porches and yards become stages for local and regional bands and musicians. Senoia’s streets become artist galleries and walk-up restaurants. During PorchFest, local musicians or bands set up on selected porches and perform for an hour. The performances can range from solo acts, to full bands, with a wide variety of selected genres. PorchFest is a FREE event to attend, organized and sponsored by the Senoia Downtown Development Authority. In addition to the music, PorchFest also includes food vendors, art displays, and kids' activities! PorchFest is a celebration of music, creativity, and community! Come enjoy live performances, support local artists, and Enjoy Senoia with us!

All performances are FREE, with tips for the musicians suggested.

Planning on attending PorchFest Senoia? Here’s what you need to know…

PorchFest is a pedestrian event. Last year’s PorchFest was attended by over 2000 music enthusiasts. The streets where PorchFest will take place will be closed to all automobile and golf cart traffic. Attendees are encouraged to park in downtown Senoia and walk to the porches and stages. Walking shoes and folding chairs are recommended. Limited golf cart shuttles will be available to get participants to the PorchFest perimeter, but no transportation will be available within the perimeter of the event.

Volunteers will be available throughout the neighborhoods to answer questions. 

Maps of the porches/performers will be posted at intersections. 

As you visit each porch and performance, please watch out for plantings in front of homes and plan to sit or stand on lawns, walkways, sidewalks or the closed street. 

Please use caution when walking on streets that are not closed to automobiles, golf carts or bicycles.

fieldData.logistics-info:
The Senoia Car Show in Senoia, GA is an annual event that showcases 500 classic and custom cars from all over Georgia. The event takes place in September and features a range of vehicles, including vintage cars, muscle cars, hot rods, and custom trucks. The Senoia Car Show is a family-friendly event that offers something for everyone. In addition to the impressive collection of cars on display, there are also food vendors, music, door prizes and activities for kids.

One of the highlights of the Senoia Car Show is the opportunity to meet and talk with car owners, who are often passionate enthusiasts who are happy to share their knowledge and stories about their vehicles. Many of the cars on display are restored to their original condition, while others have been customized with modern features and modifications.

The event is held in downtown Senoia, which is a charming and historic town located about 30 miles south of Atlanta. Visitors to the Senoia Car Show can explore the town's shops and restaurants, as well as its many historic sites and landmarks.

Overall, the Senoia Car Show is a fun and exciting event that celebrates the rich history and culture of the automobile. Whether you're a car enthusiast or just looking for a fun day out with the family, the Senoia Car Show is definitely worth checking out.

Download our show poster.

The show is open to all cars & trucks 25 years and older (1998 and older).

‍For more information, please email carshow@enjoysenoia.com

Multiple Events Within the Car Show

  • 500 collector cars
  • Pedal Car Auction - local shops have customized pedal cars to look like classic cars and hot-rods, bid on these one-of-a-kind collector items!  Proceeds to benefit the family of Toby Bowden, a retired marine and father who was killed on duty as a local tow truck driver.
  • Valve cover races - you've heard of pinewood derby races, well this is similar except with customized valve covers - fun for the kid in all of us! Click here for more info about the Valve Cover races.
  • I-58 Food drive. Please support our efforts by bringing canned goods to the designated collection points at the Senoia Car Show. The I-58 Mission follows the call of Isaiah 58. They meet the physical needs (such as food) and share the love of Christ with the Senoia area community. Click here for more info about the I-58 Mission.
  • Food Trucks - including the Varsity and other local favorites
  • Trophies include Gail Downs Memorial (Best in Show Car, Best in Show Truck) and Top 20 in Show

Senoia PorchFest is a hometown community celebration where porches and yards become stages for local and regional bands and musicians. Senoia’s streets become artist galleries and walk-up restaurants.

PorchFest Senoia will be held Sunday, September 3, 2023 from 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM. Senoia PorchFest is organized and sponsored by the Senoia Downtown Development Authority.

Attendees will enjoy:

  • Local and regional musicians and artists
  • Food trucks & drink proprietors
  • Kids activities 

All performances are FREE, with tips for the musicians suggested. 

Tickets for the VIP concert from 7:00 - 10:00 PM are available for purchase.

‍

Planning on attending PorchFest Senoia? Here’s what you need to know…

PorchFest is a pedestrian event. Last year’s PorchFest was attended by over 2000 music enthusiasts. The streets where PorchFest will take place will be closed to all automobile and golf cart traffic. Attendees are encouraged to park in downtown Senoia and walk to the porches and stages. Walking shoes and folding chairs are recommended. Limited golf cart shuttles will be available to get participants to the PorchFest perimeter, but no transportation will be available within the perimeter of the event.

Volunteers will be available throughout the neighborhoods to answer questions. 

Maps of the porches/performers will be posted at intersections. 

As you visit each porch and performance, please watch out for plantings in front of homes and plan to sit or stand on lawns, walkways, sidewalks or the closed street. 

Please use caution when walking on streets that are not closed to automobiles, golf carts or bicycles. 

For additional information please contact PorchFest@enjoysenoia.com.

Bookmark this page to visit our "day of the event" page on September 3rd. You can also install our Senoia PorchFest app on your smartphone by clicking here.

Volunteers will be available throughout the neighborhoods to answer questions. 

Maps of the porches/performers will be posted at intersections.

fieldData.logistics-info:
The Senoia Car Show in Senoia, GA is an annual event that showcases 500 classic and custom cars from all over Georgia. The event takes place in September and features a range of vehicles, including vintage cars, muscle cars, hot rods, and custom trucks. The Senoia Car Show is a family-friendly event that offers something for everyone. In addition to the impressive collection of cars on display, there are also food vendors, music, door prizes and activities for kids.

One of the highlights of the Senoia Car Show is the opportunity to meet and talk with car owners, who are often passionate enthusiasts who are happy to share their knowledge and stories about their vehicles. Many of the cars on display are restored to their original condition, while others have been customized with modern features and modifications.

The event is held in downtown Senoia, which is a charming and historic town located about 30 miles south of Atlanta. Visitors to the Senoia Car Show can explore the town's shops and restaurants, as well as its many historic sites and landmarks.

Overall, the Senoia Car Show is a fun and exciting event that celebrates the rich history and culture of the automobile. Whether you're a car enthusiast or just looking for a fun day out with the family, the Senoia Car Show is definitely worth checking out.

Download our show poster.

The show is open to all cars & trucks 25 years and older (1998 and older).

‍For more information, please email carshow@enjoysenoia.com

Multiple Events Within the Car Show

  • 500 collector cars
  • Pedal Car Auction - local shops have customized pedal cars to look like classic cars and hot-rods, bid on these one-of-a-kind collector items!  Proceeds to benefit the family of Toby Bowden, a retired marine and father who was killed on duty as a local tow truck driver.
  • Valve cover races - you've heard of pinewood derby races, well this is similar except with customized valve covers - fun for the kid in all of us! Click here for more info about the Valve Cover races.
  • I-58 Food drive. Please support our efforts by bringing canned goods to the designated collection points at the Senoia Car Show. The I-58 Mission follows the call of Isaiah 58. They meet the physical needs (such as food) and share the love of Christ with the Senoia area community. Click here for more info about the I-58 Mission.
  • Food Trucks - including the Varsity and other local favorites
  • Trophies include Gail Downs Memorial (Best in Show Car, Best in Show Truck) and Top 20 in Show

PorchFest Senoia

PorchFest Senoia is a hometown neighborhood and community celebration where porches and yards become stages for local and regional bands and musicians. Senoia’s streets become artist galleries and walk-up restaurants. PorchFest Senoia will be held Sunday, September 4, 2022 from 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM. PorchFest Senoia is a new event being organized and sponsored by the Senoia Downtown Development Authority.

Attendees will enjoy:
·      Local and regional musicians and artists
·      Food trucks & drink proprietors
·      Kids activities

All performances are FREE, with tips for the musicians suggested. VIP tickets available.

PorchFest Senoia - Band Information

PorchFest Senoia is looking for local regional talent to perform for 1 hour on Sunday, September 4, 2022 between the hours of 3:00 PM - 7:00 PM on the front porches or lawns of Senoia homes. 

This is Senoia’s first PorchFest, other regional porchfests draw 20,000 visitors. We are hoping for a large crowd, which will surely grow each and every year. 

‍

PorchFest Senoia attendees will be encouraged to tip performers in the tip jars provided or via a QR code linked to the performer’s social payment platform. Musicians may sell CD’s and/or merchandise. 

‍

To be considered for PorchFest Senoia please email a short (1 - 5 minute) performance video, a YouTube link of you performing or a link to your website where we will find performance videos to PorchFestSenoia@gmail.com.

‍

Planning on attending PorchFest Senoia? Here’s what you need to know…

  • We are grateful to the performers and hosts for donating their time and homes for this event! 
  • Don’t forget your lawn chairs or wagons. Once in Senoia you can walk to each of the host homes, find a place on the closed street in front of the participating home and enjoy the music! 
  • Make sure to stop by our information booth at the Senoia Farmer’s Market located at Travis Street, for information, maps to the hosting homes and other activities. 
  • Volunteers will be available throughout the neighborhoods to answer questions and provide printed programs.
  • As you visit each porch and performance, please watch out for plantings in front of homes and plan to sit or stand on lawns, walkways, sidewalks or the closed street. Please use caution when walking on streets that are not closed to automobiles, golf carts or bicycles. 

‍

PorchFest Senoia Homeowners Information  

Dear Potential PorchFest Senoia Homeowner, 

PorchFest Senoia is a new event organized and sponsored by the Senoia Downtown Development Authority. This is a hometown neighborhood and community celebration where porches and yards become stages for local and regional bands and musicians. Senoia’s streets will become artist galleries and walk-up restaurants.  

‍

PorchFest Senoia will be held Sunday, September 4, 2022 from 3:00 - 7:00 PM. Each home will host ONE band or musician playing for 1 hour. Each homeowner will choose either their front porch, front yard or driveway to act as their home’s ‘stage’. The street will be closed to traffic and open only to pedestrian traffic. Attendees will be directed to stay in the closed street. Attendees will be encouraged to provide their own portable chairs. Homeowners need only to provide the “stage” and electricity necessary for the performers equipment. You may opt to rope off your yard/garden. 

‍

For additional information or to confirm your participation, please contact Stephanie Reeder at 618-559-8997 or email PorchFestSenoia@gmail.com. 

‍
